messages:
marta: Heads-up — follow-up from the probation/grace RFC. I sketched a smaller change we can ship quickly to reduce thin-client abuse while keeping tenant experience smooth. PTAL.
kevin: thanks. high level?
sam: are we still keeping a separate probation bucket vs normal quota?
marta: yes, but we limit probation to a token-rate + ephemeral window. idea is short-lived soft boosts instead of long probation leases.
ana: @marta can you share the config sketch?
marta: here's the gist:
```yaml
probation:
  window_seconds: 30
  burst_tokens: 500
  decay: linear
  fallback: degrade-to-small-model
```
kevin: so a new short window that gives a burst but then decays fast. good for onboarding spikes. how do we detect gaming?
jin: add simple heuristics: repeated restarts, high retry rates, and <50% success for prompt evals over N requests => flag. Flagged clients get throttled to 10% of burst.
sam: what's the interface between ingress and probation service? I want it to be minimal.
marta: ingress will call ProbationCheck(proj_id, token_cost_estimate, request_id) -> {allowed_burst, probation_id|null}. Keep it sync and cheap.
kevin: thinking about telemetry: we need trial-level events for when probation is granted/revoked and why. otherwise ops can't tune.
jin: agree. emit events: probation.granted, probation.revoked, probation.flagged.reason=<enum>. store 7d cheap index.
ana: failure modes? what if probation service goes down?
marta: fallback logic: if probation svc unreachable -> deny bursting, allow baseline quota only. Must be fail-safe.
sam: can we reuse existing badge/lease APIs? don't want a new proto.
marta: we can piggyback on Lease v2 with a small extension field probation_window. minimal change.
ops-bot: deploy-bot: probation-service v0.1 rolled to staging at canary-3.
kevin: rollouts: enable probation only for new tenants and a 10% random rollout for existing. watch abuse signal.
jin: scope: add a consumer-side flag so SDKs can surface "on_probation" to app devs for UX hints (e.g., suggest shorter prompts).
sam: action items: 1) marta: proto change PR for Lease v2 extension. 2) jin: telemetry schema. 3) kevin: rollout plan + guardrails. 4) ops: chaos test for probation svc outage.
ana: +1 on the plan. timeline?
marta: protos PR today, staging tests tomorrow, deploy next week behind feature flag.
kevin: small note — document in the console what probation means for enterprise customers (SLA impact).
jin: will add doc blurb.
kevin: thanks team. if we see unusual churn after rollout we rollback fast. :thumbsup:
